description: Stage 4b dedicated cases: block body statements, the takeover path (StatementBuilder.CollectBodyStatements + EnableBlockBodyCatalog) and the two known gaps (same-file second block; `let a = 1` newline `{ b; }`). With the shipped default (EnableBlockBodyCatalog=false) each case asserts: (1) shell-path XML == legacy-path XML byte for byte; (2) AST node-for-node == ts.createSourceFile; (3) two parses of the same source give identical XML; (4) no StatementShape shell leaks into the shape tree. Turning the catalog on exercises the takeover path; the measured counters and the two open defects are recorded in HANDOFF-s4b.md.

stage4b.stage: Stage 4b (block body statements taken over by possible)
stage4b.description: Block body takeover: mixed let/expression body, two calls, nested block, in-block ASI, two blocks in a row, `let a = 1` newline `{ b; }` (ASI boundary before a block), mixed body, uncovered control flow inside a block (safe fallback or legacy), empty statement inside a block, three expression statements.
